subject: Chemistry
basis: Ported verbatim from the live spine on 2026-08-04, when scripts/syllabus/ingest-exam-spine.ts was retired in favour of ingest-bank-spine.ts (spine) + commit-bank-rulings.ts (rulings). The rulings themselves are the ORIGINAL JEE Mains Chemistry adjudication, previously held as inline TS maps (COVERED / COVERED_NCERT / ADJUDICATED) in that script. Verified authored-not-defaulted before porting: every one of the 298 link rows either cites a section or carries an explanatory note, so nothing here is the old script's "unruled defaults to full" fallback.
